"FreeCharge Wallet Account Linking Guide
Please follow these steps to link your FreeCharge wallet account:
Prerequisites
You need to have a FreeCharge wallet account app download address: Download Here
Your FreeCharge account needs to be bound to a normal bank card and set UPI information.
Set the default payment UPI in the FreeCharge official App (you should avoid using your mobile phone number directly or a UPI containing your mobile phone number, otherwise you may receive harassing calls at work).
Check your FreeCharge bill and make sure there is a receipt of more than 100 rupees in the last day. If not, then you can ask your relatives and friends to transfer 100 rupees to your FreeCharge and make sure the transaction record appears in your FreeCharge bill.
Make sure your FreeCharge and bound bank card are in normal condition.
Linking Process
Select FreeCharge on the tool link page.
Enter your name.
Enter FreeCharge account number.
Enter the PIN you set on our platform.
Click the Link Authorize button.
The App will open the official website of FreeCharge.
Click Login of FreeCharge.
Enter your FreeCharge account and complete FreeCharge login.
When the system detects that you have logged in to FreeCharge, it will automatically complete the link. If the system does not detect that and you have completed the login, please manually click the FINISH button in the app.
If everything goes well, you will see this prompt box.
After clicking Finish, you will return to the tool link page. You should see the UPI prompt as shown in the Finish page
After clicking Save, you will see that you have successfully linked and are in Available state.
Precautions
First make sure your account meets link prerequisites.
Avoid frequent links in a short period of time (it is generally recommended that the interval between two links be greater than 30 minutes). Frequent links may cause official risk control to prevent the account from logging in or frequently going offline.
Frequently Asked Questions and Solutions
Q: The link failed halfway?
A: Record the complete linking process video (the video needs to include the entire process of logging in to the FreeCharge account on the web page in our app).
Q: I went offline soon after the link was successful.
A: Is there no UPI tool available for your account? Did your recent statement show that your bank card was frozen? If not,please wait ten minutes. If the account does not come back online, try to link again.
